question: Should Featherless be accepted as an official external provider package in this release now that exact-head live provider proof has been posted?
rationale: The code path is additive and follows the provider plugin boundary, but official provider inclusion creates new auth/setup/model/package and publish obligations that require maintainer product and release intent.

options.title: Accept after release cleanup
options.body: Keep the external provider-plugin implementation, confirm package reservation and publish timing, remove or approve the changelog edit, then move the PR out of draft for normal merge handling.

options.title: Defer official package
options.body: Leave Featherless on generic custom-provider configuration until a later release can own the npm/ClawHub package and provider support surface.

options.title: Keep custom-provider only
options.body: Do not add an official package and document only manual custom-provider setup if maintainers do not want to own another provider package.

recommendation.title: Accept after release cleanup
recommendation.body: Keep the external provider-plugin implementation, confirm package reservation and publish timing, remove or approve the changelog edit, then move the PR out of draft for normal merge handling.
